name: Tree-sitter
description: Installs the Tree-sitter CLI for incremental parsing. Optionally compiles grammars (PHP, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, Dart, Python, YAML) from official repos.

version.description: Tree-sitter CLI version: 'latest' or a specific version (e.g. '0.25.4')

grammarPhp.description: Compile and install the PHP grammar (tree-sitter/tree-sitter-php)

grammarTypescript.description: Compile and install the TypeScript grammar (tree-sitter/tree-sitter-typescript)

grammarJavascript.description: Compile and install the JavaScript grammar (tree-sitter/tree-sitter-javascript)

grammarGo.description: Compile and install the Go grammar (tree-sitter/tree-sitter-go)

grammarDart.description: Compile and install the Dart grammar (UserNobody14/tree-sitter-dart)

grammarPython.description: Compile and install the Python grammar (tree-sitter/tree-sitter-python)

grammarYaml.description: Compile and install the YAML grammar (tree-sitter-grammars/tree-sitter-yaml)
